items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I had Eddie Rector and Baby Laurence, I had dancers like Sammy Vanderhurst

ctx.x: Yeah. I had Eddie Rector and Baby Laurence, I had dancers like Sammy Vanderhurst -- was a dancer. We had Pops and Louis. They all felt that my dancing
was too good for them, you know. They couldn't cope with me.
